projects.title: Part-Time Work Portal
projects.description: Connecting students with part-time opportunities based on locality and experience, while giving employers a place to post jobs and manage applications.
projects.problem: Students need a centralized, simple portal to find part-time opportunities. Employers need an easy way to post jobs and manage applications.
projects.approach: A React frontend and MySQL database support three user types: Admin, Employer, and Student. Employers can post openings with experience, pay, and location details. Students can browse and filter jobs by locality, type, and requirements.
learning: Building a full-stack system using React and MySQL.
Structuring separate modules for Admin, Employer, and Student.

projects.title: Carpooling Management System
projects.description: A ride-sharing application connecting drivers and riders, with map-based search, ride bookings, and separate workflows for each user.
projects.problem: Daily commuters can struggle to find convenient, affordable transport, while people driving alone have empty seats.
projects.approach: A PHP and MySQL application with Google Maps API for location-based search. Drivers register, submit license details for admin approval, and create rides with routes, dates, seats, and prices. Riders search using a map interface and book available seats.
learning: Implementing map search and geolocation with Google Maps API.
Working with PHP sessions and user authentication.
Implementing CRUD operations for rides, bookings, and users.

projects.title: CoinFlow – Personal Money Tracker
projects.description: A minimal, offline-first personal expense tracking application built with Flutter. CoinFlow helps users record daily expenses quickly, monitor spending habits, and understand their expenses through a clean dashboard with daily totals, recent transactions, and category-based insights.
projects.problem: Managing daily expenses can become difficult when users have to navigate complicated financial apps or depend on internet connectivity. There is a need for a simple and fast way to record expenses and keep track of daily spending.
projects.approach: Developed CoinFlow using Flutter with an offline-first approach. Implemented a quick two-tap expense entry flow, local data persistence using Hive, and Provider for state management. Created a clean dashboard to display today's spending, recent expenses, and category-wise insights.
learning: Building cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
Implementing local data persistence with Hive.
Structuring applications using models, providers, screens, services, and reusable widgets.

projects.title: SecureVault – Secure File Encryption & Integrity Verification
projects.description: A web-based file security application that enables users to encrypt, decrypt, and verify file integrity. SecureVault uses AES-256-GCM encryption, Argon2id password-based key derivation, and SHA-256 hashing to protect files and detect unauthorized modifications.
projects.problem: Files stored or shared digitally can be exposed to unauthorized access or modified without the user's knowledge. There is a need for a simple solution that protects sensitive files and helps users verify their integrity.
projects.approach: Developed a Flask-based application with three core functionalities: file encryption, file decryption, and integrity verification. Implemented AES-256-GCM for authenticated encryption, Argon2id for password-based key derivation, and SHA-256 for generating and comparing file fingerprints. Added automated tests to validate the application's functionality and deployed it using Vercel.
learning: Gained practical experience in cryptographic algorithms, password-based key derivation, file integrity verification, and secure file handling. Improved my understanding of Flask application development, automated testing, debugging, and deployment. Successfully validated the project with 63 passing tests.
